---
title: "Graphics of Promoter regions"
author: "Jonas J. R. Koberschinski"
---

- PSD95 encoded by DLG
- tau encoded by MAPT.
- BDNF on chr11p14.1 (GRCh38/hg38).

```{r}
# install once:
# install.packages("BiocManager")
# BiocManager::install(c("Gviz","biomaRt","GenomicRanges"))

library(Gviz)
library(biomaRt)
library(GenomicRanges)

mart <- useEnsembl(biomart = "genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl") # mouse: "mmusculus_gene_ensembl"

plot_promoters <- function(symbol, upstream = 3000, downstream = 500, genome = "hg38") {
  attrs <- c("ensembl_gene_id","hgnc_symbol","chromosome_name","transcription_start_site","strand")
  tss_df <- unique(getBM(attributes = attrs, filters = "hgnc_symbol", values = symbol, mart = mart))
  if (nrow(tss_df) == 0) stop(paste("No TSS found for", symbol))

  chr <- paste0("chr", tss_df$chromosome_name[1])

  # build promoter windows around each TSS, strand-aware
  make_win <- function(tss, strand) {
    if (strand == 1) c(start = tss - upstream, end = tss + downstream) else c(start = tss - downstream, end = tss + upstream)
  }
  wins <- t(do.call(rbind, Map(make_win, tss_df$transcription_start_site, tss_df$strand)))
  wins[wins[,1] < 1,1] <- 1

  prom_gr <- reduce(GRanges(seqnames = chr, ranges = IRanges(start = wins[,1], end = wins[,2])))
  from <- min(start(prom_gr)); to <- max(end(prom_gr))

  itrack <- IdeogramTrack(genome = genome, chromosome = chr)
  gtrack <- GenomeAxisTrack()
  grtrack <- BiomartGeneRegionTrack(
    genome = genome, biomart = mart, chromosome = gsub("^chr","",chr),
    start = from, end = to, name = paste0(symbol," transcripts"), transcriptAnnotation = "symbol"
  )
  cpg <- UcscTrack(
    genome = genome, chromosome = chr, track = "cpgIslandExt", table = "cpgIslandExt",
    trackType = "AnnotationTrack", start = "chromStart", end = "chromEnd", id = "name",
    name = "CpG islands"
  )
  prom_track <- AnnotationTrack(prom_gr, name = paste0(symbol," promoter(s)"), fill = "tomato", alpha = 0.2)

  plotTracks(list(itrack, gtrack, grtrack, cpg, prom_track), from = from, to = to)
}

# Save crisp vector graphics:
svg("BDNF_promoter.svg", width = 12, height = 3);  plot_promoters("BDNF");  dev.off()
svg("PSD95_DLG4_promoter.svg", width = 12, height = 3);  plot_promoters("DLG4");  dev.off()
svg("MAPT_tau_promoter.svg", width = 12, height = 3);  plot_promoters("MAPT");  dev.off()

# Or one PDF with all three:
pdf("BDNF_PSD95_MAPT_promoters.pdf", width = 12, height = 9)
plot_promoters("BDNF"); plot_promoters("DLG4"); plot_promoters("MAPT")
dev.off()

```
